---
layout: map
title: Projects
permalink: /projects/
---

<script>
// Project data generated by Jekyll
const cityData = {};

{% assign located = site.projects | where_exp: "p", "p.city != nil" %}
{% assign cities = located | map: "city" | uniq | sort %}

{% for city_name in cities %}
{% assign city_projects = located | where: "city", city_name | sort: "year" | reverse %}
{% assign fp = city_projects | first %}
cityData[{{ city_name | jsonify }}] = {
  lat: {{ fp.lat }},
  lng: {{ fp.lng }},
  projects: [
    {% for p in city_projects %}
    {
      title:       {{ p.title | jsonify }},
      url:         {{ p.url | jsonify }},
      year:        {{ p.year | jsonify }},
      role:        {{ p.role | default: "" | jsonify }},
      institution: {{ p.institution | default: "" | jsonify }},
      summary:     {{ p.summary | jsonify }},
      tags:        {{ p.tags | jsonify }},
      gradient:    {{ p.gradient | default: "grad-1" | jsonify }}
    }{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}
    {% endfor %}
  ]
};
{% endfor %}

// ── Map init ────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const map = L.map('world-map', {
    center: [30, 15],
    zoom: 2,
    zoomControl: false,
    minZoom: 2,
    maxZoom: 10,
    worldCopyJump: true
  });

  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
    subdomains: 'abcd',
    maxZoom: 19
  }).addTo(map);

  L.control.zoom({ position: 'bottomright' }).addTo(map);

  const panel     = document.getElementById('city-panel');
  const panelName = document.getElementById('panel-city-name');
  const panelCount= document.getElementById('panel-count');
  const panelList = document.getElementById('panel-projects');
  const hint      = document.getElementById('map-hint');
  const closeBtn  = document.getElementById('panel-close');
  let activeMarker = null;

  // Create a marker per city
  Object.entries(cityData).forEach(([cityName, data]) => {
    const count = data.projects.length;
    const size  = count > 1 ? 30 : 18;

    const icon = L.divIcon({
      className: '',
      html: `<div class="map-dot pulse" style="width:${size}px;height:${size}px;font-size:${count > 1 ? '10px' : '0'};">${count > 1 ? count : ''}</div>`,
      iconSize:   [size, size],
      iconAnchor: [size / 2, size / 2]
    });

    const marker = L.marker([data.lat, data.lng], { icon }).addTo(map);

    marker.on('click', function () {
      // Update active dot
      if (activeMarker) {
        activeMarker.getElement().querySelector('.map-dot').classList.remove('active');
      }
      marker.getElement().querySelector('.map-dot').classList.add('active');
      activeMarker = marker;

      // Hide hint
      hint.classList.add('hidden');

      // Populate panel
      panelName.textContent  = cityName;
      panelCount.textContent = count === 1 ? '1 project' : `${count} projects`;

      panelList.innerHTML = data.projects.map(p => {
        const meta = [p.role, p.institution, p.year].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
        return `
          <a class="panel-project" href="${p.url}">
            <span class="panel-project-kicker">${p.tags[0] || ''}</span>
            <div class="panel-project-title">${p.title}</div>
            <div class="panel-project-meta">${meta}</div>
            <p class="panel-project-summary">${p.summary}</p>
            <span class="panel-read-more">Read article</span>
          </a>`;
      }).join('');

      panel.classList.add('open');

      // On mobile, scroll map up a bit
      if (window.innerWidth <= 700) {
        map.panTo([data.lat, data.lng]);
      }
    });
  });

  // Close panel
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    panel.classList.remove('open');
    if (activeMarker) {
      activeMarker.getElement().querySelector('.map-dot').classList.remove('active');
      activeMarker = null;
    }
  });

  // Close on map click
  map.on('click', function () {
    panel.classList.remove('open');
    if (activeMarker) {
      activeMarker.getElement().querySelector('.map-dot').classList.remove('active');
      activeMarker = null;
    }
  });
});
</script>
